name: x_account_call
description: [Account user-X--- On-Demand Gateway] Discover and invoke nearly a hundred authenticated X account tools — count varies with X official updates — (logged in as @<YOUR_X_USERNAME>, numeric id '<YOUR_X_USER_ID>', included with Grok Bot subscription) without bloating context. Capabilities include: 1) Account & Profile: get_users_me, get_users_me_followers, get_users_me_following, get_users_timeline (home feed); 2) Bookmarks & Likes: get_users_bookmarks, get_users_bookmark_folders, get_users_bookmarks_by_folder_id, create_users_bookmark, delete_users_bookmark, get_users_liked_posts, get_posts_liking_users; 3) People, Communities & Spaces: search_users, search_communities, get_communities_by_id, search_spaces, get_spaces_by_id, get_spaces_by_creator_ids, get_spaces_posts; 4) Lists: get_lists_by_id, get_lists_posts, get_lists_members, get_lists_followers, get_users_owned_lists, get_users_followed_lists, get_users_pinned_lists, create_lists, update_lists, add_lists_member, remove_lists_member_by_user_id, follow_list, pin_list; 5) X Articles, X Chat (DMs), Scheduled Calls & Livestreams: article_create_draft, get_chat_conversations, get_chat_conversation_events, list_broadcasts, get_broadcast_chat, list_scheduled_calls. Usage: pass action='list' (optional filter='bookmark|list|space|chat|...') to inspect exact tool names and required/optional parameters locally with 0 latency; pass action='call' with tool='<tool_name>' and arguments={...} to execute against Grok Bot's user-X--- connector and get raw JSON.

action.description: 'list' returns tool schemas instantaneously (0 API calls); 'call' invokes the tool via Grok Bot user-X---.

tool.description: Required when action='call': exact tool name such as 'get_users_bookmarks', 'get_users_timeline', 'search_users', 'get_lists_posts'.

arguments.description: Required when action='call': JSON object of arguments for the target tool (for own account tools, id defaults to '<YOUR_X_USER_ID>' if omitted).
